items.name: filter-tokens
items.title: Filter Tokens (Radix UI)
items.description: Tokenized filter input component for shadcn projects using Radix UI primitives (default/legacy style). Renders the useFilterTokens() hook with tokens, dropdown, calendar, and locale-aware date/time inputs.
items.author: Francesco Carrella <francesco.carrella@gmail.com>

items.name: filter-tokens-base
items.title: Filter Tokens (Base UI)
items.description: Tokenized filter input component for shadcn projects using Base UI primitives (base-* styles). Renders the useFilterTokens() hook with tokens, dropdown, calendar, and locale-aware date/time inputs.
items.author: Francesco Carrella <francesco.carrella@gmail.com>
